I saw a post stating most data scientist do not know advanced algorithms. 80%
out there are only aware of logistics regression and only very few can talk in
length on GAN, LSTM and all Now to know Logistics regression one has to
understand 👉 Linearity and converting non linear features to linear 👉
correlation analysis and reverse causality 👉 Multicollinearity 👉 Variable
Selection/Reduction 👉 Interaction variables 👉 segmentation 👉 Normality
👉Homoscedasticity 👉 Handling monotonic relationship How is above concept not
advanced ? One who masters above concept can work on any complex problem
rather copying or cloning GAN code from github and running it Complexity of
concept comes from complexity of underlying problem rather using advanced
algorithms I have seen regular logistics regression model saving million of
dollars for enterprise and GAN, LSTM not even fitting majority of enterprise
problem hashtag#datascience

profile_headline: Data Science | ML | Co-founder and CTO at Recreate.ai | LinkedIn Content Creator | Mantissa DS Meetups
post_content:
All programmers are not cut from the same cloth. Different programmers have
different preferences. Data Scientists are a kind of programmers as well. They
enjoy building stuff but not of all kind. They mostly enjoy working with data
and products that could be built out of that. They enjoy different ways of
manipulating and storing data but they don't really want to build the
infrastructure for it. They enjoy visualising data and plotting graphs. Most
of the other kind of programmers don't really enjoy building reports and
dashboards, but people in data like to work on these things. From the outside,
these differences might not even look like big differences. If you can program
in Python (and program well), surely you can do a lot of things. It might look
like you can build websites using web frameworks, build games, do some
application programming. But just because you can, doesn't mean you would
enjoy building everything! Data Scientists, are therefore, a unique kind of
programmers who enjoy certain aspects of programming and building. Just like
other kinds of programmers. What do you think? hashtag#datascience
hashtag#programming hashtag#python hashtag#building hashtag#webframeworks
